class.name: Device
class.brief_description: A device in a 3D world that boots OpenDust OS on its screen.
class.description: A tablet, phone, wall terminal or any other object with a screen. The device owns a [SubViewport] running an [OSShell] and a quad mesh that displays it. Entering the tree registers the device with the world's [OSKernel] (creating the kernel if this is the first device), and the [member boot_app] opens when the node is ready. All devices in a world share the kernel's [WorldDrive], so a note written on one is readable on every other. Forward input events with [method push_input] to let a player interact with the screen.

method.name: get_session
method.description: The session signed in on this device.

method.name: get_room_id
method.description: The [code]room_id[/code] of the nearest ancestor [code]Room[/code] (from the [code]opendust_slate[/code] module), or an empty string.

method.name: sleep
method.description: Stops rendering the screen and dims it.

method.name: receive_message
method.description: Called by the kernel when a bus message is delivered to this device. Shows a notification and emits [signal message_received].

method.name: push_input
method.description: Forwards an input event to the screen's viewport (in the screen's local coordinates).

members.member: Durable id of this device. Generated on first enter-tree if empty. Set it explicitly for devices that should keep their identity across saves.
Physical size of the screen quad, in meters.
App opened when the device is ready.
